# The arrival of a_usd_arrival_booked_to_the_directors_account.txt with its US
# dollar split moved to a second US dollar bank, for `--strategy update`.
#
# The cost basis sits on that split, so it would move to the second bank with
# it, while the 0.72 USD fee drawn on it stays on the first, taking the first
# bank to −0.72. The cost basis would not stand for what either bank holds, so
# the edit is refused, and the refusal says which cost basis would move.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_an_edit_may_move_the_split_that_sets_the_rate.py.
